summary: Register the existing affiliate marketplace, provider-feed, ProductIdentity and Offer Registry modules as explicit source members of the existing shared control-api boundary for the Generation-8 EKODI Mall affiliate marketing account hub.
approvalBasis: The platform owner instructed EKODI to build the affiliate marketing account settings as an eighth-generation operating hub and, after the constitutional approval gate was reported, explicitly instructed the work to continue through completion.
boundaryRule: This amendment does not create a new deployment boundary. affiliate-marketplace.js, affiliate-provider-feed.js, product-identity.js and Offer Registry modules remain inside the existing api.ekodi.kr shared control plane and its guarded deployment owner.
authorityRule: Affiliate account ledgers, provider credentials and merchant-route mutations remain central-admin authority. Tenant-local Mall Admin receives only bounded operating projections and no platform affiliate credential authority.
recommendationRule: Merchant offers fail closed until affiliate, tracking, product/price freshness and administrator recommendation gates are ready. Commission rate is not a ranking signal.
dataRule: Provider credentials remain server-side. Seller-neutral product identity and verified price facts are stored only through existing governed control-plane schemas and additive migrations.
verificationPolicy: Constitution, platform boundaries, security baseline, deployment guardrails, affiliate/admin contract tests, Mall doctor, full repository tests, PR staging and production smoke verification must pass.
rollback: Revert the affiliate marketplace control modules and migrations from the shared control-api release, restore the previous affiliate-only source registration, and keep existing Coupang operation fail-safe. No destructive data rollback is permitted.
